scopeLimits: The WUP point is a population-cluster locator, not a municipal boundary or official parcel identity. A single point hit or an unsuccessful point-centered geometry request cannot establish citywide coverage. No personal owner, address, tax, account, or applicant data was requested or retained; no authentication, CAPTCHA, credentials, or token was used.
name: Konya
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: The official TKGM Konya regional directory lists Konya Kadastro Müdürlüğü and central Meram Tapu Müdürlüğü. TKGM documents a public parcel/coordinate viewer and states that owner name or Turkish ID cannot be used for public queries. An anonymous exact WUP-point request returned a valid closed Polygon identified administratively as Konya / Meram / Öğretmenevleri; only geometry and a synthetic ID from public parcel keys were retained.
technicalBlocker: Two bounded production-adapter checks obtained seven distinct public parcel IDs and re-read their full geometries, but nearby point requests repeatedly failed without an HTTP response and a valid-format absence response remained unverified. Independent GEOS audits reproduce invalid geometry in TR-TKGM-128083-812-81 in both source WGS84 and metric coordinates. Konya remains held without repairing or excluding that parcel. Point/exact lookup is a supported source mode; its lack of area enumeration is a scope limit, not the reason for this hold.
remainingUncertainty: Area coverage, update vintage, reuse terms for automated access, and polygon integrity outside the one sampled point. No citywide or arbitrary-area enumeration is verified.
nextStep: Review the original invalid source parcel and reliable public point/exact absence responses before enabling Konya.
